objective: Make Ron OS continuation resilient without slowing ordinary chats: keep BOOTSTRAP as the single entry point, conditionally route material strategic decisions to the frozen Strategic Life Trajectory Plan, use raw/public GitHub only as a transport fallback when the connected GitHub read path fails, and treat any dated recovery snapshot as stale emergency evidence rather than a second current owner.

roles_before.artifact: Self-contained/general requests answer directly without loading Ron OS.
BOOTSTRAP.md is the canonical entry point for current-state/prior-decision/continuation work.
GitHub Ron OS owns canonical files while claim-specific live owners own mutable app/external truth.
ChatGPT memory may only point to BOOTSTRAP and must not own mutable Ron OS state.
Strategic Context Orchestration selects real-world outcomes while preserving focus continuity, live truth and reward-after-outcome semantics.
External live-source writes retain the exact-permission gate in PROTOCOL.md.
Base SHA preserves pre-change routing and recovery semantics.

role_dispositions.destination: Ordinary/self-contained requests still bypass Ron OS; the strategic plan is conditional rather than global.
BOOTSTRAP.md remains the one canonical entry point and gains only conditional routing/recovery rules.
Raw GitHub is only an alternate transport to the same main files; recovery snapshots never become current owners.
Memory remains an optional pointer only; no SHA, quest, balance or other mutable state is moved into memory.
Material trajectory/focus/System Pulse decisions additionally read the frozen strategic plan; current System strategy/focus/reward semantics remain intact.
No mutation authority changes; fallback reads do not authorize writes.
Recorded base SHA remains the exact rollback point.

capability_probes.assertion: A self-contained ordinary request still answers directly and does not load Ron OS or the strategic plan.
A materially important trajectory choice, System Pulse, or cross-direction focus/quest selection cannot miss STRATEGIC_LIFE_TRAJECTORY_PLAN_V1.md after starting at BOOTSTRAP.md.
Simple System status/profile/XP/current-quest lookup does not load the strategic life plan merely because it is a System request.
If the connected GitHub read path fails while the repository is public/reachable, the same main path may be read through raw GitHub without creating a second owner or dual-read requirement.
When canonical GitHub is unavailable, a dated recovery snapshot is stale emergency evidence only; mutable/current claims remain UNVERIFIED and no canonical promotion/write is made from the snapshot.
Calendar/TickTick/Cronometer/Liftosaur/XMind/marketplace writes still require Ron's exact explicit permission.
The recorded base SHA reconstructs the previous routing behavior.

tests.expected: Conditional strategic-plan routing, connector->raw fallback, snapshot fail-closed boundary and memory-pointer-only rules are present.
Existing architecture, continuity, System controller, XMind and capital routing guards remain green.
